NUTRITION
  PLAN "Insulin-sensitivity, no under-fuelling":
    PRINCIPLES:
      - "Prioritise whole-foods with moderate carbohydrate distribution across the day to avoid large glucose spikes."
      - "Protein at each meal: ~25-35g to support muscle recovery and lean mass."
      - "Energy intake at or slightly above maintenance to avoid under-fuelling; adjust based on weight and performance."
      - "Include healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts) and fibre (vegetables, legumes, whole grains) to improve glycaemic response."
      - "Time carbs around training (pre- and post-session) to support performance and recovery."
      - "Limit high-sugar processed foods and large boluses of refined carbs."
    TARGETS:
      - "Protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight per day (aim mid-range)."
      - "Carbohydrate: moderate, spread across meals; higher on training days, lower on rest days."
      - "Fat: remaining calories from healthy fats; do not restrict below ~25% of energy."
      - "Calories: start at maintenance or +5% depending on goals; avoid deficits >250 kcal/day without clinical oversight."
    EXAMPLE_DAY:
      - "Breakfast: whole-grain porridge or eggs + veg + fruit (small) — protein 25-35g."
      - "Lunch: lean protein + mixed salad/veg + quinoa or sweet potato — moderate carbs."
      - "Snack: Greek yogurt or cottage cheese + berries + nuts."
      - "Dinner: protein (fish/chicken/legumes) + large vegetables + small whole grain portion."
      - "Post-workout: protein shake or meal with carbs + protein within 1-2h."
    MONITORING:
      - "Track energy, sleep, training performance, and menstrual changes. Adjust calories if performance or recovery drops."
      - "Consider working with dietitian for personalised calorie targets and medication interactions."
    SAFE_ADVICE:
      - "If on glucose-lowering medication, coordinate changes with prescribing clinician before altering carbs."
      - "Avoid aggressive calorie restriction; focus on consistent adequate intake and progressive resistance training."
